newsitem.title: MEXICO: Telmex to recoup $422 mln for investment.
newsitem.headline: Telmex to recoup $422 mln for investment.

text.p: The long distance concession holders of Telefonos de Mexico (Telmex) will have to contribute $422 million to help Telmex recover its investment in opening local line service, the Federal Telecommunications Commission (Cofetel) said on Monday.

"We will have to recover $422 million in investments made by Telmex for local service and all the holders of long distance service concessions will have to contribute to this, including Telmex," said Carlos Casasus, president of Cofetel, at a news conference on Monday.
The Commission said the funds would be needed for five different aspects of the local service sector.
